grades.main_gap: Lemma 2/Corollary 3 (every essential prime eventually divides every term) is false — the write-up's own example contradicts it (e.g., a_11 = 50 lacks factor 3) — and its proof is invalid; the central stabilization step is unjustified.
grades.notes: Correct hitting-set reformulation and a workable conditional endgame (Parts 3–4, though Lemma 6 cites a false gcd identity). The heart of the problem—stabilization of the hitting-set structure—is established only via a false lemma with a hand-wavy proof, so the derived L and V are wrong; internal inconsistency with the example.
